Following prenylation, these proteins… 12217662 post-prenylation-processing-enzymes-as-new-targets-in-oncogenesis post prenylation processing enzymes as new targets oncogenesis RAS and many other oncogenic proteins undergo a complex series of post-translational modifications that are initiated by the addition Post-prenylation-processing enzymes as new targets in oncogenesis RAS and many other oncogenic proteins undergo a complex series of post-translational modifications that are initiated by the addition of an isoprenoid lipid through a process known as prenylation. Following prenylation, these proteins usually undergo endoproteolytic processing by the RCE1 protease and then carboxyl methylation by a unique methyltransferase known as isoprenylcysteine carboxyl methyltransferase (ICMT). Although inhibitors that have been designed to target the prenylation step are now in advanced-stage clinical trials, their utility and efficacy seem to be limited.
